Container.Name: OpenGym
Container.Overview: Self-hosted workout & body-weight tracker: plan routines, log workouts (supersets, warm-ups, cardio), see which muscles are trained or detrained, import from FitNotes/Strong/Hevy, sign in with passkeys. Your data, your server.
Container.Requires: Passkeys are the default login mechanism and they require an HTTPS domain to work properly. If you don't have an HTTPS domain, then enable PASSWORD_LOGIN for a standard user/password login.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Users, passkeys, session secrets, and media uploads.

Config.Name: Origin
Config.Description: The full address, scheme and port included, e.g. https://gym.example.com or http://192.168.1.1:8310. Must match the browser URL exactly otherwise sign-ups and sign-ins are refused due to origin-mismatch.

Config.Name: Password Login
Config.Description: Enable user password logins. Passkeys remain the default login mechanism.

Config.Name: First User Admin
Config.Description: The first profile created on an empty instance becomes its admin. Acts only while no profile exists.

Config.Name: Allow Guest
Config.Description: Allow guest accounts to use the application. Guest data is stored in the browser.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Tell the app to trust the X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP request headers that a proxy adds on a visitor's behalf.

Config.Name: Invite Only
Config.Description: Gate new profiles behind an invite code generated by an admin. Create an admin profile first before enabling this.

Config.Name: Hostname
Config.Description: The application's hostname, e.g. gym.example.com (no scheme, no port). Required for WebAuthn/passkey logins.

Config.Name: Admin UIDs
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of account IDs (Settings > Account > Account ID) that are granted access to the admin dashboard.

Config.Name: Base Path
Config.Description: Set this only for reverse proxy subpath deployments where the proxy forwards the prefix to the app. Use a leading slash and no trailing slash, e.g. /gym. Leave empty to serve at the site root.

Config.Name: CF Connecting IP
Config.Description: Leave empty unless Cloudflare is really in front. Cloudflare users set $http_cf_connecting_ip (with the dollar sign). Empty drops the header so a direct client cannot forge the recorded address.
